title: v1_110 / Extension Authoring
content:
## Extension Authoring

### Webviews and Custom Editors can now use ThemeIcons for their icon path

[Webview Panels](https://code.visualstudio.com/api/extension-guides/webview) and custom editors can now use a [`ThemeIcon`](https://microsoft.github.io/vscode-codicons/dist/codicon.html) as their editor tab icon:

```ts
webviewPanel.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon('octoface');
```

![Screenshot showing the 'octoface' theme icon used for a webview tab icon.](images/1_110/webview-icon.png)

### Portable mode detection API finalized

The `env.isAppPortable` API is now stable and available to all extensions without requiring `enabledApiProposals`.

Use this API to detect whether VS Code is running in [portable mode](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/portable), which is enabled when the app runs from a folder containing a `data` directory.

```ts
if (vscode.env.isAppPortable) {
  // Running in portable mode - adjust behavior accordingly
}
```
